candidates.title: Will Alex Michelsen win at least 3.5 more games than Yannick Hanfmann?
candidates.rules_primary: If the game differential in favor of Alex Michelsen across the full match is above 3.5 games in the Alex Michelsen vs Yannick Hanfmann professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP Stockholm 1/16 Finals, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to the Alex Michelsen vs Yannick Hanfmann professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP Stockholm 1/16 Finals. If the match does not occur (signaled by a ball being played) due to a player injury, walkover, forfeiture, or any other cancellation (all before the match starts), the market will resolve to a fair price in accordance with the rules. If this match is postponed or delayed, the market will remain open and close after the rescheduled match has finished (within two weeks). If a retirement occurs, all markets that can be unconditionally settled based on play already completed will resolve accordingly. Any markets that cannot be unconditionally settled will resolve to Fair Market Price, as determined at the sole discretion of the Exchange.

candidates.title: James Cook III receiving yards ladder
candidates.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays $0.0025 per receiving yard recorded by James Cook III during the Buffalo vs Minnesota Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 9, 2026. Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Yes pays out at most $1.00. Then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
This is a scalar market. The Yes payout per contract is $0.0025 per receiving yard constrained between $0.00–$1.00 with a cap at 400 yards. The No payout is $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Payouts are proportional to the size of the holder's position. For example, 80 receiving yards pays Yes $0.20 and No $0.80; 200 yards pays Yes $0.50 and No $0.50; zero yards pay Yes $0.00 and No $1.00.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the NFL. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.
